name: cricket-learner-ai
description: Direct install cricket learning app with AI coaching, quizzes, mini games, Pro Learning hooks, and admin moderation flow.

scripts.check: node --check app-config.js && node --check app.js && node --check sw.js && node --check server.js && node --check macos/electron/main.js && node --check macos/electron/preload.js && node -e "for (const f of ['manifest.webmanifest','play-store/twa-manifest.template.json','play-store/assetlinks.template.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))"
scripts.android:check: node -e "for (const f of ['manifest.webmanifest','play-store/twa-manifest.template.json','play-store/assetlinks.template.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); console.log('Android package templates OK')"
